readme:
# Redfin Scraper

Get for-sale listings from [Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/) search pages. Paste the address of a city, neighborhood, county or ZIP code page and the actor returns one record per home: address, price, beds, baths, size, lot size, year built, price per square foot, HOA dues, status, days on market, property type, coordinates, photos, open houses and the listing description. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per home for sale (including coming soon) on the pages you give.
- Up to 350 homes per page address, returned in a single request, so runs are quick and small.
- Several pages in one run. Set `maxResults` and the actor works through the pages in order.
- Optional filters for price, bedrooms and property type.
- Each home once per run, even if it appears on more than one page.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/redfin-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `redfin-scraper` to list 100 homes for sale in Austin, TX with price, beds, baths, square feet and days on market as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `property_id`, `listing_id` | `31934340`, `224851332` |
| `mls_id` | `"4740035"` |
| `url` | Listing page on redfin.com |
| `street_address`, `unit_number` | `"114 Mist Flower Dr"`, `""` |
| `city`, `state`, `zip`, `country_code` | `"Pflugerville"`, `"TX"`, `"78660"`, `"US"` |
| `neighborhood` | `"WILDFLOWER SEC 5"` |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | `30.4200217`, `-97.6585859` |
| `price`, `currency` | `300000`, `"USD"` |
| `beds`, `baths`, `full_baths`, `partial_baths` | `4`, `2.5`, `2`, `1` |
| `sqft`, `lot_size_sqft` | `2070`, `435` |
| `year_built` | `1999` |
| `price_per_sqft` | `145` |
| `hoa_monthly` | `11` |
| `stories`, `garage_spaces`, `parking_spaces` | `2`, `0`, `2` |
| `status` | `"Active"`, `"Coming Soon"` or `"New"` |
| `days_on_market` | `8` |
| `listed_on` | Date the home first appeared on Redfin, worked out at run time |
| `last_sold_date` | Date of the last recorded sale, when shown |
| `property_type`, `property_type_code` | `"House"`, `1` |
| `is_new_construction`, `is_hot`, `is_redfin_listing` | `false`, `false`, `true` |
| `description` | Listing text |
| `key_facts`, `tags` | Highlights and tags shown on the listing |
| `photo_count`, `photo_urls` | `30`, up to 60 photo links |
| `virtual_tour_url`, `has_video_tour`, `has_3d_tour` | 3D tour link and flags |
| `open_houses` | Start, end and label of each open house |
| `listing_agent_name`, `listing_agent_id` | Agent name and Redfin agent id, as shown on the listing |
| `co_broker_name` | Co-listing brokerage, when shown |
| `building_id`, `building_url` | For condo and apartment units |
| `region_id`, `source_url`, `scraped_at` | The search the home came from and the time of the run |

Fields that a listing does not show are returned empty. Phone numbers and email addresses of agents are not part of the data.

## Input

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `startUrls` | Redfin city, neighborhood, county or ZIP code page addresses. |
| `maxResults` | Most listings to return across all pages. Default 200. |
| `minPrice`, `maxPrice` | Price range in USD. Optional. |
| `minBeds` | Minimum bedrooms. Optional. |
| `propertyTypes` | Any of `house`, `condo`, `townhouse`, `multi-family`, `land`, `mobile`, `co-op`, `other`. Optional. |

### Example: one city

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin"],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### Example: two cities, houses and condos from 300,000 to 700,000 USD with 3 or more bedrooms

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin",
    "https://www.redfin.com/city/16904/CA/San-Diego"
  ],
  "maxResults": 300,
  "minPrice": 300000,
  "maxPrice": 700000,
  "minBeds": 3,
  "propertyTypes": ["house", "condo"]
}
```

## Pricing

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Listing scraped (`redfin-listing-result`) | $0.0006 per listing ($0.60 per 1,000) |

The start fee is charged once per run, together with the first saved listings. A run that saves nothing is not charged.

## Limitations

- Each page address gives at most 350 homes. Redfin does not return more for one area in one request. For a larger city, use several neighborhood or ZIP code pages.
- Only homes for sale and coming soon are returned. Sold and rental listings are not included.
- The price, bedroom and property type filters are applied after the homes are read, so a narrow filter on a large area can return fewer homes than `maxResults`.
- A ZIP code page needs one extra page load to find its area, which makes that page slower.
- A page address with an area id that Redfin does not know returns no listings.
- The listing brokerage is shown by Redfin only for some listings. Most records have the listing agent name but no brokerage name.
- `listed_on` is worked out from the time a home has been on Redfin, so it can differ by a day from the date on the listing.
- Contact details of agents (phone, email) are not collected.
- Redfin may change its pages. If a run cannot read any listing, it ends with a failed status and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Which addresses should I use?**
Open a city, neighborhood, county or ZIP code search on redfin.com and copy the address from the browser. City and neighborhood addresses look like `https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin`.

**Can I search by typing a city name?**
Not in this version. Use the page address from redfin.com.

**How many homes can I get?**
Up to 350 per page address. Add more addresses to cover more areas.

**What does a run cost?**
The start fee plus the price per 1,000 listings, as shown in the pricing table. A run of 200 listings is charged for 200 listings.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many listings were delivered. If Redfin refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If an area has no homes for sale, the run ends normally and says so.

**Does it return sold homes or rentals?**
No. It returns homes that are for sale or coming soon.

**Does the data include agent phone numbers?**
No. The agent name and id shown on the listing are included; contact details are not.
